rv.q: In an era of international musicals, this unashamedly British night out is a change and a treat.
Despite its flaws, it's refreshing to see a new musical that, probably for the first time since Our House, revels in its London setting and unapologetic Britishness.
Just how much you warm to it will largely depend on your wish to revisit a beloved TV series in this new but hardly revelatory format.
